# Zenexio

> Zenexio is a full-service creative agency based in Dubai, UAE, with a delivery team in India, offering graphic design, web development, digital marketing, and brand strategy for businesses across the UAE and India.

Zenexio has delivered 500+ projects since founding in 2017. The agency is known for transparent, scoped pricing, replies within one business day, and giving clients full ownership of source files and usage rights.

## Company facts

- Founded: 2017
- Headquarters: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Also serves: India
- Services: Graphic Design, Web Development, Digital Marketing, Brand Strategy, Motion Design
- Contact: info@zenexio.pro | +971 503 848523
- Website: https://www.zenexio.pro
